info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Delete Connect Components Configuration By Configuration Id-v5-spec
info.description: The Manage Connect Components Configuration API allows users to permanently remove specific configurations identified by their unique configuration ID. This operation is critical for maintaining an up-to-date set of configurations within the system and ensuring that outdated or irrelevant configurations are eliminated. Ideal for administrators and developers managing component integrations, this API streamlines the process of configuration optimization and management. It targets use cases such as application maintenance, system clean-up, and integration management.

delete.description: This endpoint allows you to permanently delete the configuration resource identified by its unique identifier. Ensure that the resource is no longer needed before performing this action, as it cannot be undone.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to specify the parameters needed to delete the configuration identified by the unique identifier RES-100045. Ensure that the request body adheres to the defined schema to successfully process the deletion.

204.description: Request completed successfully, no content returned.
